relevance_protocol.acceptance_metric: constrained original-rank gain: topical grade >0 and constraint != denied
relevance_protocol.adoption_fit: unknown unless separately assessed; never implied by relevance
relevance_protocol.grade0: assessed described function outside goal; no source-supported direct or supporting contribution
relevance_protocol.grade1: explicit adjacent/supporting function or sparse source requiring verification
relevance_protocol.grade2: explicit core function with a requested detail unobserved
relevance_protocol.grade3: explicit core goal and specific requested capability
relevance_protocol.unconditional_topical_metrics: mandatory parallel diagnostics including denied positives

actual.purpose: Capacity, measured latency/memory/bytes and relevance only after actual CP-11 captures use these exact pins and complete judgments.

headroom.purpose: Deterministic headroom only; repeated or generated rows cannot prove relevance, catalog growth or product usefulness.

measurement.cold_definition: New read-only process and SQLite connection for each sample; OS cache state is recorded rather than claimed flushed.
measurement.warm_definition: Same read-only process and immutable index after one discarded warm-up query; no index writes or rebuild.
